needed.suggestion: Add a pedestrian refuge island at the crossing to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait when crossing a wide road.
Install dropped kerbs at the crossing to improve accessibility for pedestrians with mobility aids and wheelchairs.
Install street lighting along the road to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers, especially during low-light conditions.
